answer: Registration requires a costly proof-of-work signal tied to a unique hardware secret, so spinning up fake agents burns real compute and capital. Each agent must lock stake in a vault that slashes on duplicate identity proofs. A hollow identity with no stake emits no valid signal and is ignored. Attackers must pay per identity, making mass sybil swarms economically irrational. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
